title: What Does a Computer Do?
style: calm luminous storybook watercolor with clear cutaway mechanisms

pages.text: A computer can show pictures, play songs, and help you write.

quickWords.th: คอมพิวเตอร์

pages.text: A computer takes in information, follows instructions, and produces a result.

quickWords.th: ข้อมูลที่ป้อนเข้าไป

pages.text: A tap, typed word, picture, or sound can be input. Input is information a computer receives.

quickWords.th: ข้อมูลที่ป้อนเข้าไป

pages.text: People create programs with instructions. Computers follow these instructions to do different jobs.
Output is information a computer produces. It can be a picture, sound, words, or movement.

quickWords.th: การเคลื่อนไหว

pages.text: Computers can carry out many instructions very fast. Speed helps them do big jobs one small step at a time.
A computer follows the exact instructions in its program. If the instructions are wrong, the output can be wrong too.

quickWords.th: คำสั่งที่ชัดเจน

pages.text: A washing machine has a small computer inside. A traffic-light system uses a controller in a roadside cabinet.

quickWords.th: เครื่องซักผ้า

pages.text: Can you find a computer with a screen and one without a screen?

quickWords.th: คอมพิวเตอร์
